001: Hello, I'm here for the interview. This is my resume.
Hello, please have a seat. First, tell me a little about yourself.
I graduated from Peking University and have five years of experience in marketing.
So why did you choose our company?
Because your company's direction fits very well with my career plans.
Okay, I see. Let's continue talking about your project experience.
002: What are the main skills required for this position?
We value communication skills and teamwork the most.
I've led a team of eight people before, so communication shouldn't be a problem.
Then how would you handle it when the team disagrees?
I would first listen to everyone's views, then organize a discussion.
That's a good approach. I can see you have management experience.
003: What areas do you think I still need to improve on?
Your professional skills are strong, but your industry knowledge could go deeper.
That's true. I've been recently taking courses related to the industry on my own.
Very good. A proactive learning attitude is important.
Thank you for your advice. I'll keep working hard.
Then let's talk about your salary expectations.
004: My expected monthly salary is around twenty thousand. Is that negotiable?
That range is within our budget, so it shouldn't be a problem.
Great. Does the company offer training opportunities?
Yes, we have regular professional training every year.
And what is the promotion system like?
We have a performance review once a year, and if you do well, there are promotion opportunities.
005: Does this position require frequent business trips?
Occasionally, about once or twice a month.
No problem. I'm quite used to the pace of traveling for work.
Can you accept working overtime on short notice?
Yes, working overtime is normal when a project is urgent.
Great. Your attitude is very positive, and I appreciate that.
006: My previous job was a bit different from this position.
That's fine. I can see you have strong learning abilities.
Yes, when I changed careers, I taught myself for three months and got the hang of it.
Do you have confidence in adapting to a new environment quickly?
Of course. I've always been very adaptable.
Good. Then let's do a simple case analysis.
007: Suppose a client suddenly cancels the partnership. What would you do?
I would first find out the reason for the cancellation, then propose a solution.
What if the client insists on not working together?
Then I would adjust the strategy in time and look for new opportunities.
That's a thorough answer. You think things through very carefully.
008: What is the company's main customer base right now?
We mainly serve small and medium-sized business clients.
I've worked with that type of client before, so I'm quite familiar with them.
That's great. Do you have relevant connections?
I have some, and I can help the company expand new business.
That's exactly what we need most right now.
009: I'd like to know about the team's work atmosphere.
Our team atmosphere is very relaxed, and everyone helps each other.
Do you have team-building activities regularly?
Yes, we organize one every quarter.
That sounds really nice. I'm looking forward to joining.
We're looking forward to having you too. We'll let you know the result soon.
010: When will the interview results come out?
We'll notify you by phone within three days.
Okay, I'll wait for your message.
Thank you for coming to the interview today. You did very well.
Thank you. I really hope I can join your company.
